hooks.text: 有限场地让选塔与站位都成为关键，邻接关系还能触发像猫塔搭配牛奶塔这样的专属协同。
hooks.excerpt: The field has limited room, so your choice of Towers matters, as does Tower placement. For example, a Cat Tower gets bonuses from milk, so it makes sense to put it next to a Milk Tower.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 塔在战斗中被摧毁后会于下回合完整恢复并保留加成，同类塔还能向上堆叠以强化属性与专属能力。
hooks.excerpt: All Towers destroyed during battle are fully restored next round, keeping all received bonuses. Don’t hesitate to invest in Tower upgrades, they stay forever! STACK TOWERS Combine Towers of the same type to stack them higher. Taller Towers have improved stats and stronger unique abilities!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 商店每回合随机加入塔，玩家要根据当下供给即时调整策略，或冒险等待目标塔来塑造不同跑局。
hooks.excerpt: Random generation: Random Towers are added to the Tower Store each turn. Adapt your strategy around what you can buy here and now, or take the risk and wait for the Tower you want! Either way, no two runs will be the same!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
